name: navigation-menu
title: Navigation Menu
description: A short horizontal menu of top-level links where Products and Docs carry chevrons and open a bordered panel of two-line destinations. Hovering a trigger highlights it and flips its chevron while the panel slides in.
use: A header needs a few top-level destinations whose contents are worth previewing in a panel.
avoid: Panels open on hover, so touch users must tap and the panel then covers page content.
a11y: Triggers open by hover, click or keyboard and roles come from the primitive, but the slide and zoom ignore reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three light grey links in a row on black, with small chevrons after Products and Docs. An open trigger gets a soft grey rounded background, and a dark bordered panel drops below holding bold titles stacked over muted description lines.
behaves: Hovering or clicking a trigger opens its panel with a short slide and fade while the chevron turns upward; moving to another trigger swaps the panel in place. Clicking outside closes it.
customise: You build the row from items, triggers, panels and links, each taking classes; turning viewport off anchors each panel to its own trigger instead of a shared box.
weight: light: A few links and one floating panel; nothing runs while the menu is closed.
